b8_boundary.statement: Portable candidate identity is mapped here, but Manifest and connector_instance_ref wire Schemas remain B8.

source_local_identity_mappings.exact_rule: Environment input COMPLETED_EXECUTION_FEED_SOURCE_INSTANCE matching ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:-]{0,127}$ when enabled.
source_local_identity_mappings.binding: Exact value appears as FeedPage.source_instance and is included in cursor HMAC domain separation.
not_equal_to: shared connector_instance_ref unless B8 explicitly maps it

source_local_identity_mappings.exact_rule: Product-local composite primary key and control state.
source_local_identity_mappings.binding: Scopes pause/resume, receiver acknowledgement and last authenticated credential.

source_local_identity_mappings.exact_rule: Product-local project-scoped service credential ID; lifecycle feed_staged, feed_active, feed_revoked or disabled.
source_local_identity_mappings.binding: Purpose, project, exact host network and no allowed models are enforced by the read-route auth gate.

source_local_identity_mappings.exact_rule: Internal idempotency and materialization key only.
source_local_identity_mappings.binding: Successful processing joins usage journal and Feed materialization; Feed request uniqueness is (org_id, request_id).

source_local_identity_mappings.exact_rule: Source-local retained ordering and cursor authority.
source_local_identity_mappings.binding: Opaque cursor encodes version, project_id and sequence, then signs with Source instance binding.

read_surface.authorization: Project-scoped service credential, feed_active for active connection; feed_staged accepted only for paused connection; exact host network binding; no model-call authority.
read_surface.source_instance_binding: Same exact configured value binds Feed page producer identity and cursor HMAC domain.
read_surface.cursor: Opaque Source transport token; excluded from Event identity/hash and owned Consumer Checkpoint semantics.

product_local_control_routes.operation: revoke product-local credential and pause connection
cancel and revoke staged product-local rotation

identity_exclusions: page generation, fetch, receive or ingestion time
compatibility_invariants: Current read route, page Schema and capability remain unchanged.
Portable identity never grants UniRouter routing, billing, IAM or code-extension authority.
source_instance remains exact and stable for a logical producer; changing it creates a different identity domain.
No shared identifier replaces product-local connection, credential, Outbox or Feed sequence identities.
No credential value, secret, live endpoint host or runtime state is recorded in this artifact.
